title: ¶ A prologe into the.iiii. Euangelyſtes ſhewynge what they were & their auctoryte. And fyrſt of S. Mathew.

segments.text: AS towchynge ye euāgelyſtes: ye ſe in ye new teſtament clearly what they were Fyrſt mathew (as ye reade Mat ix. Mar. ii. Luke. v) was one of chriſte apoſtles / and was with chriſt all the tyme of his preachynge / and ſawe and heard his awne ſelfe almoſt all that he wrote.
